e.title: Loss Models Computer Labs
e.summary: Loss Models 课程计算实验室（Antonio/Crevecoeur/Robben，2025-12）：经典精算教材配套 R 动手实验
e.body: Loss Models Computer Labs（katrienantonio/loss-models-computer-labs，6★）是 Katrien Antonio、Jonas Crevecoeur 与 Jens Robben（KU Leuven）为《Loss Models》课程（精算损失模型标准教材，CAS/SOA 考试基础）制作的计算实验室材料（2025 年 12 月课程）：损失分布拟合、聚合损失模型等的 R 动手实验。对 RIAA：Loss Models 教材的配套实验——与 [[lossmodels]]（OpenActuarial 损失模型包）、[[reservingmodels]]（准备金模型）、[[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]]（Antonio 准备金工作坊）配套；课程导向（SOA/CAS 考试科目 Exam STAM 对应内容）学习友好。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Antonio 等 KU Leuven Loss Models 计算实验室（2025-12），学术教育背书入池
e.summary_en: Computer labs for the Loss Models course (Antonio/Crevecoeur/Robben, 2025-12): R hands-on labs for the classic actuarial textbook
e.summary_hk: Loss Models 課程計算實驗室（Antonio/Crevecoeur/Robben，2025-12）：經典精算教材配套 R 動手實驗
e.body_en: Loss Models Computer Labs (katrienantonio/loss-models-computer-labs, 6★) is the computer-labs material by Katrien Antonio, Jonas Crevecoeur and Jens Robben (KU Leuven) for the Loss Models course (the standard actuarial loss-modelling textbook, the basis of CAS/SOA exams): R hands-on labs on loss-distribution fitting, aggregate loss models, etc. (December 2025 course). For RIAA: companion labs for the Loss Models textbook — with [[lossmodels]] (OpenActuarial loss-models package), [[reservingmodels]] (reserving models) and [[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]] (Antonio's reserving workshop) they form a coherent learning chain; course-oriented (maps to the Exam-STAM content of SOA/CAS exams).
e.body_hk: Loss Models Computer Labs（katrienantonio/loss-models-computer-labs，6★）是 Katrien Antonio、Jonas Crevecoeur 與 Jens Robben（KU Leuven）為《Loss Models》課程（精算損失模型標準教材，CAS/SOA 考試基礎）製作的計算實驗室材料（2025 年 12 月課程）：損失分佈擬合、聚合損失模型等的 R 動手實驗。對 RIAA：Loss Models 教材的配套實驗——與 [[lossmodels]]（OpenActuarial 損失模型套件）、[[reservingmodels]]（準備金模型）、[[workshop-loss-reserv-fraud]]（Antonio 準備金工作坊）配套；課程導向（對應 SOA/CAS 考試科目內容）學習友好。
